seo.title: Morocco Transport & Car Rental | High-Speed Trains, Transfers & Taxis
seo.description: Find the best ways to travel around Morocco: Al Boraq high-speed train, private airport transfers, 4x4 & car rental, CTM intercity buses, and local taxis across 40+ Moroccan cities.
seo.og_description: Comprehensive travel guide to getting around Morocco: high-speed trains, car hire, airport shuttles, and intercity buses.

hero.title: Getting Around Morocco: High-Speed Trains, Car Hire & Transfers
hero.description: Navigate Morocco with ease and confidence. Compare options for the Al Boraq high-speed train (ONCF), private airport transfers, 4x4 desert car rentals, CTM intercity coaches, and city taxis across 40+ destinations.

intro_p1: Morocco boasts one of Africa's most modern and efficient transportation networks. From Al Boraq—Africa's first ultra-high-speed train connecting Tangier, Rabat, and Casablanca in under two hours—to smooth modern highways winding through the High Atlas, traveling across the country is comfortable and accessible.
intro_p2: Whether you prefer the freedom of self-driving a 4x4 into Sahara dunes, reserving a hassle-free door-to-door private airport shuttle, or riding iconic petit taxis through vibrant medinas, our guide helps you choose the best route for your itinerary and budget.

train.title: Al Boraq High-Speed Train (ONCF)
train.desc: Travel up to 320 km/h on Africa’s fastest bullet train. Connect Tangier to Casablanca in just 2h10m with Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and 1st/2nd class comfort.
train.tip: Book via ONCF website or app

car.title: Car Rental & Self-Drive
car.desc: Renting a car gives complete freedom to explore coastal highways, Atlas mountain passes, and hidden villages at your own pace with well-maintained toll roads.

fourxfour.title: 4x4 & SUV Desert Rentals
fourxfour.desc: Essential for tackling rocky desert tracks, crossing Atlas mountain gorges, and reaching remote Sahara sand dunes like Merzouga or Erg Chigaga safely.

transfer.title: Private Airport Transfers
transfer.desc: Skip the taxi queues with pre-booked private transfers. Drivers greet you at airport arrivals with a sign and take you directly to your Riad or hotel door.

bus.title: Intercity Luxury Coaches (CTM & Supratours)
bus.desc: Modern air-conditioned coaches with assigned seating, reclining seats, and luggage holds. CTM and Supratours reliably connect every city, town, and mountain valley.

taxi.title: Petit & Grand Taxis
taxi.sub: Color-Coded City Taxis & Regional Shared Taxis
taxi.desc: Each city has color-coded Petit Taxis (metered urban trips). Grand Taxis operate regional routes between neighboring cities and towns with fixed per-seat fares.

flights.title: Domestic Flights (RAM & Air Arabia)
flights.desc: Save travel time across long distances. Direct domestic flights quickly bridge Casablanca to Dakhla, Errachidia, Ouarzazate, Tangier, and Agadir.

minivan.title: Private Minivan & Chauffeur Hire
minivan.desc: Perfect for families and group tours. Hire a private licensed English-speaking driver and spacious luxury van for multi-day custom Morocco road trips.

tram.title: Modern Tramway Systems
tram.desc: Sleek, air-conditioned light rail tramways offer effortless navigation through Casablanca and Rabat, linking train stations, city centers, and monuments cheaply.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Transport in Morocco
faq.subtitle: Essential tips on train tickets, car hire requirements, driver licenses, and airport transfer tips.
faq.q1: Do I need an International Driving Permit (IDP) to rent a car in Morocco?
faq.a1: In most cases, a valid driver's license from your home country (written in Roman letters, such as EU, US, UK, Canadian) is accepted for tourist car rentals up to 90 days. An International Driving Permit is recommended for extra clarity during police checkpoints.
faq.q2: How far in advance should I book Al Boraq high-speed train tickets?
faq.a2: We recommend booking ONCF Al Boraq tickets at least 3 to 7 days in advance online to secure cheap promo fares and first-class seats, especially during weekend peak hours between Tangier, Rabat, and Casablanca.
faq.q3: What is the difference between Petit Taxis and Grand Taxis?
faq.a3: Petit Taxis operate exclusively within city borders, carry up to 3 passengers, and use a fare meter (compteur). Grand Taxis operate regional routes between towns or to airports, carry up to 6 passengers, and charge fixed per-seat fares.
faq.q4: Why pre-book private airport transfers instead of taking an airport taxi?
faq.a4: Pre-booked airport transfers guarantee fixed upfront prices, flight tracking for delays, luggage assistance, and direct door-to-door escort to your Riad inside car-free medina alleys without price haggling after a long flight.
